items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But any way I did quite a few recordings with Mildred, as a matter of fact I recorded with Mildred in Chicago before I left Chicago to go to New York.

ctx.x: That escaped me. I can't remember, and I have some --- I'm sure I have quite a few of the 78's at home. Maybe it'll come to me just a little later. But any way I did quite a few recordings with Mildred, as a matter of fact I recorded with Mildred in Chicago before I left Chicago to go to New York. She used to come to the Three Deuces all

the time, and she loved the band, and she recorded with our band. The only addition to our band at that time was Herbie Haymer, who was quite a saxophone player. He was working with she and Red Norver.
